info.title: GIS 3D Backend API
info.description: API for GIS region/building data and aggregate SIR simulation.

get.description: Returns building footprints from PostGIS ordered by UUID ascending. An out-of-range page returns HTTP 200 with an empty data array.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of records per page; maximum 500.

200.description: Building page, including an empty page when no records match.

example.error: region_id must be a valid UUID

get.description: Returns regions ordered by code ascending. An empty result is HTTP 200 with an empty data array.

example.error: region_id must be a valid UUID
building_id must be a valid UUID

post.description: Runs the deterministic aggregate SIR engine synchronously. The response includes the initial state (time_step 0) and one point for each requested integration step. beta and gamma are rates in inverse time units; dt uses that same caller-defined time unit.

400.description: Malformed JSON, missing/incorrect fields, or invalid SIR parameters.

500.description: Numerical instability or unexpected internal error. Internal details are not exposed.

get.description: Returns nearby buildings using minimum footprint-to-footprint distance. Source footprints are EPSG:4326 and are cast to geography for meter-based filtering and distance output. Invalid/empty/non-4326 neighbor geometries are excluded and counted. The center building must have a valid, non-empty EPSG:4326 footprint.

200.description: Neighbor list; an empty data array is a valid result.

400.description: Invalid UUID, radius, limit, or invalid center footprint.

example.error: radius_m must be greater than 0 and no greater than 5000

post.summary: Initialize SIR state for selected buildings
post.description: Creates a persisted spatial simulation run from an explicit list of building UUIDs. Population is manual; buildings without population are excluded with a persisted reason. Retries with the same request_id and payload return the existing run.

200.description: Idempotent replay of an existing run.

400.description: Invalid request, unknown building, or no eligible buildings.

409.description: request_id was previously used with a different payload.

post.summary: Run and persist building-level SIR simulation
post.description: Executes synchronous Euler updates for every eligible building using the KAN-23 local and distance-weighted neighbor infection pressure. Results are persisted atomically for time_step 0 through steps. Population is manually supplied during initialization. Same configuration retries are idempotent.

200.description: Idempotent replay of an already completed run.

201.description: Simulation completed and all building/time-step results persisted.

400.description: Invalid model parameters, initial states, or resource limits.

409.description: Run already completed with a different configuration or is not executable.

500.description: Numerical or persistence failure; no partial result set is marked completed.

get.summary: Get spatial SIR simulation run status
get.description: Returns lifecycle status and persisted result counts. Detailed time-series retrieval is provided by the spatial simulation results API.

get.summary: List building SIR results at a simulation time step
get.description: Returns a stable page of building-level results. Population is read from the same simulation's initialized building state. Only completed runs are readable. Aggregate totals are exposed by the separate aggregate endpoint and are independent of pagination.

200.description: Building results for the selected snapshot.

404.description: Simulation or requested time_step/region does not exist.

409.description: Simulation has not completed; error is simulation_not_completed.

get.summary: Get aggregate SIR for a simulation snapshot
get.description: Returns totals over all matching buildings, optionally filtered by region. This calculation is never limited by the building-results pagination endpoint.

200.description: Aggregate SIR totals for the requested snapshot.

404.description: Simulation or requested time_step/region does not exist.

409.description: Simulation has not completed; error is simulation_not_completed.

post.summary: Set risk classification thresholds for a completed simulation
post.description: Stores a versioned risk_classification snapshot inside simulation_runs.simulation_config without replacing SIR configuration. Defaults are Low <= 5%, Medium <= 15%, High > 15%. These are academic visualization thresholds, not medical standards.

200.description: Per-building risk classification, including unclassified exclusions.

404.description: Simulation, region, or time step not found.

get.summary: Get regional risk aggregates independent of pagination

200.description: Regional counts, population, infected totals, weighted infection ratio, and risk buckets.

404.description: Simulation, region, or time step not found.

coordinates.description: GeoJSON coordinates in longitude, latitude order (EPSG:4326).

total.description: Total matching records after region filtering.

population.description: Total population; finite and greater than zero.

beta.description: Transmission rate in inverse caller-defined time units.

gamma.description: Recovery rate in inverse caller-defined time units.

dt.description: Integration interval in the same time unit as beta and gamma.

SirSimulationRequest.description: Initial susceptible + infected + recovered must equal population within the domain tolerance. dt × steps must not exceed 10,000 caller-defined time units.

point_count.description: Number of returned points; always steps + 1, including the initial state.

distance_m.description: Minimum distance between the two footprints, in meters.

excluded_invalid_geometry_count.description: Total count of invalid, empty, or non-EPSG:4326 building footprints in public.buildings; these records are excluded from neighbor candidates.

population.description: Manual population. Omit to exclude this building.

initial_infected.description: Required when population is provided; explicit zero is valid.

beta.description: Transmission rate in inverse caller-defined time units.

gamma.description: Recovery rate in inverse caller-defined time units.

dt.description: Euler timestep in the same time unit as beta and gamma.

steps.description: Number of Euler steps; effective result rows are limited to 250000 and buildings to 500.
